title: Collapse the two config parsers into one resolve_role
action: Per D1 (store cd72ec97), make the drivers module the ONE parser of the models.<runtime> config shape and have the model-guard call it instead of carrying a second implementation. Delete the guard's private resolve_tier (model_guard.rs:442-467) and its resolve_advisor (:470-483); route all guard call sites through the drivers implementation (models.rs:318-383, :387-437). Two behaviors need a DECISION, not a lift, and the cap must record which you chose and why: (a) the guard's parser is purpose-blind and refuses every cli-shaped slot unconditionally (model_guard.rs:441 comment, :456 Slot::Cli => Resolved::Refused) while the surviving one is purpose-parameterized via purpose_is_gather (models.rs:341-348, prepare.rs:44-45) — each guard call site (model_guard.rs:497, 725, 818, 882, 936, 978) must be given a purpose deliberately, and :978, driven by a [bee-tier] marker on a claude Task, is genuinely ambiguous between cell and gather; (b) configured_model_set (:495-510) matches only Resolved::Model today, deliberately excluding Resolved::Native — the drivers enum carries an equally readable model string on Native (models.rs:268-288), so a naive port silently widens what the guard admits. Keep Native out. This cell changes NO behavior: it is a collapse. Four tests call the guard's private three-arg resolve_tier directly (model_guard.rs:1252, 1256, 1260, 1266) against the guard's own Resolved enum, whose variants differ in shape from the drivers enum — retarget them, keeping every assertion. Do not open the role set, do not touch the closed lists, do not change any refusal text: those are mrs-2 and mrs-3.

truths: Exactly one implementation parses the models.<runtime> shape; the guard has no private resolve_tier or resolve_advisor left
Every assertion the four private-resolve_tier tests made is still made from the new call site — none deleted
A cli-shaped slot behaves in the guard exactly as the cap's recorded purpose choice implies, and that choice is written on the cap per call site
Resolved::Native still contributes no model to configured_model_set
The full suite is green and no refusal text changed

trace.outcome: The model-guard's private models parser is deleted; verbs::drivers is now the one parser, called with an explicit purpose at every guard call site
deviations: PURPOSE CHOICE (a): all six guard call sites take GUARD_PURPOSE = "cell", the one non-gather purpose (purpose_is_gather is kind != "cell"), so a cli-shaped slot still resolves to Resolved::Refused exactly as the deleted purpose-blind parser refused it. Reason: the guard's whole surface is Agent/Task/spawn_agent, an in-family subagent that can no more BE an external cli process than it can be a herding pane. Per site: :725 marker+param, :818 marker-only, :882 pinned-type, :936 bare-FIX all reach a subagent verdict, so cell. configured_model_set is cell so a cli slot contributes no member, as today. derive_dispatch_economics (the ambiguous [bee-tier]-on-a-claude-Task site) is cell because the audit line must record the model the verdict above was reached on; it is behavior-free either way, since Resolved::Refused and Resolved::Cli both name no model.

NATIVE KEPT OUT (b): configured_model_set matches Resolved::Model only, on both the slot loop and the advisor arm; Resolved::Native carries a readable model string in the drivers enum and a naive port would have widened membership. Commented in place as deliberate.

Herding fallback now reads the resolved value (Resolved::Herding { fallback }) instead of the raw slot; the deleted enum's Herding was a unit variant, which is the only reason the old code peeked at the raw slot. Same review-falls-back-to-generation rule, applied inside the shared resolve_tier.

Deleted more than the cell named literally: the guard's Slot/Slots/Models types and its normalize_tier_value/normalize_models went with resolve_tier/resolve_advisor. They ARE the second parser of the models.<runtime> shape, so leaving them would break must-have 1.

packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/models.rs was reserved and read but needed NO change: it already holds the surviving purpose-parameterized implementation. A collapse deletes the duplicate; it does not edit the survivor.
